title: This Is Me: A Reckoning
author: Hayden Panettiere
engineRationale: A celebrity memoir carried by a specific, nameable real person (Hayden Panettiere) and concrete documentary life-scenes — Nashville, the Heroes cheerleader, the custody fight, rehab, her brother's death — which photoreal Flux cut-outs of the real figure (Vox) portray far better than a generic vector everyman.
